rule.name: JpaVersion
rule.message: Add a @Version field next to the @Id, so concurrent updates fail instead of overwriting each other. Mark entities that are never updated with @Immutable.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[(pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Entity') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Entity')) or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.MappedSuperclass') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.MappedSuperclass'))]] [(not(ExtendsList) and ModifierList/Annotation[(pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Entity') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Entity'))]) or ClassBody/(FieldDeclaration | MethodDeclaration)/ModifierList/Annotation[ (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Id') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Id')) or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.EmbeddedId') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.EmbeddedId'))]] [not(ModifierList/Annotation[pmd-java:typeIs('org.hibernate.annotations.Immutable')])] [not(ClassBody/(FieldDeclaration | MethodDeclaration)/ModifierList/Annotation[(pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Version') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Version'))])] /ModifierList/Annotation[(pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.Entity') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.Entity')) or (pmd-java:typeIs('jakarta.persistence.MappedSuperclass') or pmd-java:typeIs('javax.persistence.MappedSuperclass'))]
